summary: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a monthly operational press release reporting preliminary September 2026 terminal passenger traffic, the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K. Total passengers fell 7.3% year over year; the 12 Mexican airports declined 6.7%, with Tijuana down 12.1%, Puerto Vallarta 10.4% and Los Cabos 7.5%, plus Montego Bay down 16.6% and Kingston 3.8%. Management attributed the drop to reduced airline seat capacity, mainly domestic, and Hurricane Polo disruptions. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are involved; traffic trends are the sole risk-arb angle.
